</p><p><span style="color: #333333; font-size: small;">The Chinese classic known as Shanhai Jing is a compilation of descriptions of medicines, creatures and geographic features. Its authors are unknown, numerous, and believed to all be from the Warring States Period. Depicted above is Peng Wu, the witch [30].</span></p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>&nbsp;
	

</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<b style="color: #333333;"><span style="font-size: 2em">Twelfth Stratagem</span></b></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333;"><b><span style="font-size: x-large;"><br /></span></b></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<b style="color: #333333;"><span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: x-large;"><span lang="zh-CN">顺手牵羊</span></span></b></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">(shùn shǒu qiān yáng)</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><i>Lead Away a Goat in Passing</i></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
<span style="font-family: inherit;">The phrase refers to an old story of a wanderer that passed through a
flock of sheep, and then emerged with one in tow as if he had entered
the flock this way. 
</span></span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">
Plans should be carried out with flexibility enough to take advantage
of any opportunity, however small, thereby accruing a profit, however
slight.</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">
There was a military leader and philosopher of law by the name of Wu
Qi (<span><span lang="zh-CN">吴起</span></span>,
440-381 B.C.) during the Warring States Period. Circumstances,
including estrangement from his home state of Wei, led Wu Qi to the State of Chu where he was eventually appointed Prime
Minister by King Dao (<span><span lang="zh-CN">楚悼王</span></span>,
401-381 B.C.). He passed several reforms that strengthened Chu, but
that also enraged the old nobility.</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">
In the wake of these reforms, Chu was soon on its way to defeating
both the State of Yue in the South and the State of Wei in the North.
King Dao, however, died that same year, and the old nobles plotted to
assassinate Wu Qi at the funeral if they were able to separate him
from his army. At the funeral, Wu Qi quickly spotted the assassins
and clung to the deceased King Dao's body, using it as a shield. Many
arrows struck the dead King before Wu Qi was finally killed. The new
King Su (<span><span lang="zh-CN">楚肃王</span></span>,
380-370 B.C.) was furious at the mutilation of his father's body, and
ordered that all of the nobles involved be executed, along with their
families [27].</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><span><span lang="en-US"><i><span style="font-weight: normal;">Lead
Away a Goat in Passing</span></i></span></span><span><span lang="en-US">
is associated with the nineteenth hexagram, </span></span><span><span lang="en-US"><i>Earth
over Lake</i></span></span><span><span lang="en-US">.
Here the Earth can be thought of as overlooking the Lake, and
symbolizing the position on high, where one oversees and takes
advantage of opportunity with immediacy </span></span><span><span lang="en-US">[1],
[28]</span></span><span><span lang="en-US">.</span></span></span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US">&nbsp;</span></span></span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US">&nbsp;</span></span></span>

<div dir="ltr" id="Section64" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	1) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">请带一瓶水给我。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: Please bring me a
	bottle of water.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	2) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你要不要我把你的行李袋带去飞机场？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: Do you want me to
	bring your luggage to the airport?</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	3) I: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我的笔记本在哪？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">II:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">我把它放进你的包里了。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">III:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">那请把它拿出来，带给我。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	4) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">请你把垃圾拿出来。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">5)</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times;"> </span></span><span style="color: #0047AB !important; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times; color: #0047AB !important;">这些香蕉是我今天在小店顺手买的。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">6)</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times;"> </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important; font-family: times;">你想牵这头羊吗？</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	5) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">饭店在哪？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">在公园的旁边。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	6) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我的车停在超市和银行之间。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	7) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我刚刚从洛杉矶飞到香港，我很累。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	8)  Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我们刚到，那个宾馆离这里近吗？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">对不起，宾馆离这里很远。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	9)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">她比他离我近。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	10) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">银行比学校离超市近。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	11) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你应该穿外套，外面很冷。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	12) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你的衣服还在行李袋里面。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	13) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我的书在不在包里面？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; <span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US">A:</span></span><span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif">
	</span><span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">不在，在外面。</span></span></span></p>
</div>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<br /></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><a href="https://apecrank.blogspot.com/2011/03/notes-from-china-chapter-11-sacrifice.html">Previous Chapter</a>
</p>
